# Test data: made-up values

These snapshots exist only to test the engine. Every number, name and source here is made up, so the maths can be checked by hand.
Never copy them into `data/snapshots/`, and never show them as real results.

The minutes are chosen so that, in the 2026-04-01 snapshot (newest model: 60 minutes at the start of 2026, doubling once a year, office-work factor 50), each doubling of a task's minutes adds exactly one year.
